executionBlocker.requiredCapability: A purpose-specific x402 purchase tool backed by an isolated low-value wallet/signer. The LLM must not receive or be able to reveal a raw private key. The payment layer must enforce Base + USDC only, an approved-provider allowlist, per-call and session spend caps, no arbitrary transfer method, audit logging, and a kill switch.
executionBlocker.recommendedImplementation: First preference: a managed agent wallet/MCP or isolated signer that exposes only bounded x402 purchase operations. Start on testnet where supported, then fund a dedicated mainnet operating wallet with only the benchmark allowance. Do not place a general-purpose wallet private key in James prompts, repository files, logs, Airtable, Drive, or agent-readable configuration.
